# @oxog/json

Zero-dependency JSON toolkit for TypeScript.

## Install

```
npm install @oxog/json
```

## Core API

```typescript
import { json } from '@oxog/json';

// Parse/stringify
json.parse(text, options?)
json.safeParse(text)  // Returns { ok, value } | { ok, error }
json.stringify(value, options?)

// Deep property access
json.get(obj, path, fallback?)
json.set(obj, path, value)
json.has(obj, path)
json.remove(obj, path)
json.paths(obj)

// Options
parse: { reviver?, maxDepth?, maxLength? }
stringify: { indent?, replacer?, circular?, sortKeys? }
```

## Optional Plugins

```typescript
import { 
  pathPlugin,
  transformPlugin,
  diffPlugin,
  patchPlugin,
  schemaPlugin,
  streamPlugin,
  repairPlugin,
  json5Plugin,
  typePlugin,
  immutablePlugin
} from '@oxog/json/plugins';

json.use(plugin1, plugin2, ...);
```

### Available Plugins

- `pathPlugin` - JSONPath: `json.query(data, '$.store.books[*].title')`
- `transformPlugin` - `merge`, `flatten`, `unflatten`, `pick`, `omit`, `sortKeys`, `mapValues`, `filterValues`
- `diffPlugin` - `json.diff(before, after)` → RFC 6902 patch
- `patchPlugin` - `json.patch(obj, ops)`
- `schemaPlugin` - `json.validate(data, schema)`, `json.compile(schema)`, `json.is(data, schema)`
- `streamPlugin` - `json.stream.parse(readable)`, `json.stream.parseLines(readable)`
- `repairPlugin` - `json.repair(text)` → fixed JSON
- `json5Plugin` - `json.parse5(text)`, `json.stringify5(value)`
- `typePlugin` - `json.infer(data, { name })` → TypeScript interface string
- `immutablePlugin` - `json.freeze(obj)`, `json.immutableSet(obj, path, val)`

## Presets

```typescript
import { preset } from '@oxog/json/plugins';
json.use(preset.full);      // All plugins
json.use(preset.minimal);   // transform + repair
json.use(preset.validation); // schema + type
```

## Factory

```typescript
import { createJson } from '@oxog/json';
const j = createJson({ parse: { maxDepth: 50 } });
```

## Errors

| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| JSON_PARSE_ERROR | Invalid JSON |
| JSON_PATH_ERROR | Invalid path |
| JSON_SCHEMA_ERROR | Validation failed |
| PLUGIN_ERROR | Plugin error |
